feeds.notes: Standard Clarity: …/CO/<EID>/<version>/json/en/summary.json. 245,848 bytes decoded, 25,119 on the wire (gzip). Version-pinned URL is Cache-Control: max-age=86400; a new count gets a new version number.

election_id: 127407 (Clarity EID), the path segment after /CO/. Version at fetch time: 386671.
discovery: GET https://results.enr.clarityelections.com/CO/elections.json and take the EID whose Date is the election day; then …/CO/<EID>/current_ver.txt for the version.
cors: *  (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on elections.json, current_ver.txt, summary.json and electionsettings.json)
bot_blocking: Plain relay User-Agent: 200 on all four files (CloudFront). Browser User-Agent not needed, not tried.
updated_field: electionsettings.json → websiteupdatedat, e.g. '11/10/2026 3:56:49 PM MST' (US Mountain local time with the zone abbreviation in the string). summary.json itself carries no timestamp; its Last-Modified header was Tue, 10 Nov 2026 22:54:36 GMT.
reporting_field: Per contest in summary.json: PR (reporting) and TP (total), counted in COUNTIES for Colorado, not precincts (United States Senator: PR 25, TP 64 — 64 counties, a county counts as reporting only when complete). Statewide in electionsettings.json: stateprecinctsreporting 712, stateprecinctspartiallyreporting 3568, stateprecinctsparticipating 4297.

choice_format: Parallel arrays per contest: CH (names) ['Mark Baisley', 'John Hickenlooper', …], P (party codes) ['REP', 'DEM', 'FWD', 'APV', 'LBR', 'UNI'], V (votes) [934667, 1613055, …], PCT. Governor is a ticket: 'Phil Weiser / Lesley Dahlkemper'. Measures: CH ['Yes/For', 'No/Against'] with P ['Y', 'N']; judicial retention: CH ['Yes', 'No'], P ['Y', 'N']. Nonpartisan RTD seats have P ['1', '2'] (ballot positions, not parties).
district_field: Only in the title C ('… - District 7'). K is a contest key (20, 110, 1010, 2001 …) whose digits loosely track the district (State Representative District 1 = K 2001) but it is not a district field. CAT gives the group ('Federal Offices').
